summary: Learn agent safety, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop design through practical exercises, governance tools, and real workflow controls.
lede: Agent safety training teaches professionals to constrain AI agents with policies, access controls, and human review. It is for AI product managers, automation leads, governance analysts, risk managers, solution architects, and machine learning operations specialists who need to set escalation rules and document oversight. Participants learn to map risks and approval thresholds, design review workflows, and validate outputs through consistency checks, PII redaction, regression testing, and audit trails.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to control AI agent behavior, define escalation rules, and document human oversight in real operating environments.
prerequisites: Participants should have working familiarity with AI assistants or workflow automation concepts, plus basic exposure to risk, compliance, product, operations, or solution design roles. No programming is required for completion, although familiarity with digital workflow tools, approval processes, and AI platform administration will help you apply the exercises more confidently. Advanced concepts such as policy-as-configuration, auditability, and regression testing are taught at an operational level, not as software engineering implementation.
